title: Call site de TTL/sweep de aprovacoes no inicio de cada turno + helper de varredura periodica
authority: P2-1 remediation assignment; controlled local scope only; evidence in docs/04_audit/evidence/AAA/AAA-07/sweep-callsite/

finding.before: ApprovalEngine.releaseExpired had no production call site; the governed runtime only swept the effect journal at turn start (runtime.ts:425), and no periodic worker sweep existed (condition AAA03-R3-F03).
finding.after: Every governed turn sweeps the tenant's expired approval reservations at start (same place as the journal sweep): releaseExpired(no_effect) -> APPROVED; EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN/CONFIRMED or missing/lookup-failed evidence -> UNCERTAIN. Sweep failure denies with approval_sweep_failed before policy/model/tool/outbox. A tenant-wide helper (sweepExpiredApprovals) is exported for the future periodic worker; apps/worker is intentionally not wired (AAA-19).

change: approvalSweepEvidence (runtime.ts:183): journal-state evidence mapping; absent/RESERVED/ABANDONED/EFFECT_FAILED -> no_effect; EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN/CONFIRMED -> unknown
approvalOperationKey (runtime.ts:~217): derived operationKey recomputation from the approval proposal (no caller idempotency key)
collectApprovalSweepEvidence (runtime.ts:231): tenant RESERVED/EXECUTING evidence map; lookup failure or proposalHash mismatch never releases
sweepExpiredApprovals (runtime.ts:271, exported): periodic worker helper wrapping approvals.releaseExpired with bounded reservationTtlMs (default 60s)
runTurn (runtime.ts:565): approval sweep at turn start after the journal sweep; failure -> audit + denied approval_sweep_failed
#runExecutionTurn (runtime.ts:1116): an UNCERTAIN approval denies operation_uncertain before any reserve

changedFiles.change: P2-1 start-of-turn releaseExpired sweep suite (6 cases): orphaned RESERVED with journal RESERVED->ABANDONED; reservation without effect evidence; EFFECT_STARTED uncertainty; approval_sweep_failed; journal lookup failure; exported periodic helper. Tool/outbox never called in all cases.

unchanged: packages/approval-engine/** (releaseExpired semantics consumed as-is; no engine edit)
docs/99_runtime_state.md, docs/20_master_execution_log.md, docs/30_backlog_master.md (write scope of this task excludes them; see limitations)

red.result: 4 failed | 12 passed (16): release to APPROVED (2), UNCERTAIN on EFFECT_STARTED-equivalent, approval_sweep_failed — all failed because no approval sweep existed

full.result: 196 files passed | 4 skipped (200); 1160 tests passed | 57 skipped (1217); baseline 1154/57 preserved, +6 new tests, zero failures

guarantees: The sweep never executes an effect: it only lists approvals, reads the effect journal and transitions approval state; tests assert toolExecutor/outbox are never called.

Expired RESERVED/EXECUTING without EFFECT_STARTED returns to APPROVED (journal absent/RESERVED/ABANDONED/EFFECT_FAILED); EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN/CONFIRMED keeps an honest UNCERTAIN requiring explicit reconciliation (T-18).
Missing evidence, journal lookup failure and proposalHash mismatch are never converted into a release.
Sweep failure is fail-closed with the stable code approval_sweep_failed before policy evaluation, model call, tool or outbox; no effect is authorized and no tool/outbox runs.
Reservation TTL is the existing runtime option (reservationTtlMs, default 60s) passed to releaseExpired; no new option or unbounded default.
Periodic worker sweep exists only as the exported helper sweepExpiredApprovals; no apps/worker wiring (AAA-19).
